**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that SPTBN2 and RAB7A function in completely independent cellular pathways with no downstream convergence on neuronal health or lysosomal function, or identification of a common causal variant with a frequency >1% in gnomAD. _(variant: rs12345678)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role in lysosomal trafficking and neuronal maintenance could reveal therapeutic strategies targeting lysosomal function or axonal transport for both spastic paraplegia and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease.

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanistic overlap between these two forms of female infertility, particularly concerning the roles of SPTBN2 and TUBB8 in meiosis and oocyte maturation, could pave the way for novel therapeutic strategies targeting these pathways to improve fertility outcomes. This could involve gene therapy approaches or small molecule interventions aimed at restoring proper spindle function or oocyte maturation.
